verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover each part of the story. Python editor scripting automates asset tasks such as LOD generation, drives custom UIs and builds pipelines to other 3D apps. Editor automation covers scripted Actor placement in Levels and custom asset import pipelines. Plugins can explicitly extend the Editor, reflection metadata adds Editor functionality, and the Remote Control API can call any Blueprint-callable function. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that editor scripting and plugin tooling work as documented.
